description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pohaddaramulla, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530014 and other Title Settlements
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for specific parcels of land in Kalutara District. It contains detailed land parcel numbers, ownership details, property descriptions, and legal determinations regarding land titles, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
